notices.title: State cancellation statement near the signature and duplicate NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form
notices.trigger: Home solicitation sale of $5.00 or more, personally solicited or consummated at the consumer's residence or place of business or employment
notices.support: The price floor is "$5.00 or more" (not $25)
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of 9 V.S.A. 2454 (cancellation rules, refunds, goods return, seller duties) around the statement and the NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form; printing it would put non-notice statute text in the customer's contract.
notices.summary_row: Home solicitation: statement beside the signature, NOTICE OF CANCELLATION, oral notice, language rule, no pay for services

changes.new: Three business days; home solicitation sales of $5.00 or more
changes.support: The price floor is "$5.00 or more" (not $25)

changes.new: Sales of $5.00 or more personally solicited or consummated at the consumer's residence or place of business or employment, on top of the federal rule; a contract signed at the kitchen table is covered even when the customer invited the visit
changes.support: A sale merely CONSUMMATED at the home counts, so a contract signed at the customer's kitchen table is covered even when the customer invited the visit.
SATURDAY DOES NOT COUNT in Vermont (it does under the federal rule)

changes.new: Business day excludes Saturday, Sunday and holidays, so the Vermont deadline can fall later than the federal one; print the later date. The three business days start only when the seller complies with the disclosure subsection
changes.support: The cancellation period of three business days shall begin to run from the time the seller complies with this subsection
(D) In addition to the written notice of cancellation the seller shall orally inform the buyer of his or her right to cancel at the time of the transaction.
If the home solicitation sale is principally negotiated in a language other than English, then all of the disclosures required by this section shall be given in that language.

changes.new: Down payment up to half of the cost of labor, or half of the price of materials, whichever is greater; with no maximum price, as negotiated by the parties
changes.support: With no maximum price, "as negotiated by the parties".

unsure: VT-cancel: the statute covers sales consummated at the consumer's residence or place of business or employment, but the builder only knows 'sold at the customer's home', so a sale at a place of business is not caught by applies.
cancellation.no_work_or_payment_in_window left unchanged: the statute says the seller is entitled to no compensation for services performed before cancellation, which is not a ban on starting work.
